research.text: My research covers several systems areas including networking and operating systems, but my specialty is embedded systems. research.text: Our group research focuses on the central theme of light-atom interaction and its crucial role in quantum optical communication and sensing. research.text: My lab focuses on application of computational modeling in medical imaging and medical device instrumentation. We are particularly interested in simulation-guided assessment and enhancement of safety of magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in patients with implants, including but not limited to those with neuromodulation devices (such as deep brain stimulation systems) and cardiovascular electronic devices. We work hand in hand with major MRI vendors (Siemens) medical device companies (Abbott, Boston Scientific, Medtronic), FDA regulatory experts, and clinicians to devise novel surgical and technological methodologies to enhance safety of MRI in pediatric and adult patient populations with medical implants.
